messages:
anya: Sharing the latest iteration of the Capacity modal — Figma here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/elastic-capacity (frame: 'Modal / Scaling Configurator'). Looking for quick UX + accessibility pass. Key areas: min/max controls, burst toggle, GPU pool selector, SLO slider and guardrail warnings. sam: Looked through — overall nice. A few nits: - The min/max inputs read as raw numbers; can we surface units (vGPU or GPUs) inline? People get confused when the pool has mixed GPUs. - Slider granularity: current SLO slider snaps every 5%, feels coarse. Recommend step=1 for precision, but show ticks at 5/10 for visual simplicity. - The burst toggle label should read `Enable burst (short-term on-demand capacity)` — folks didn't know what "burst" means. Tooltip + help link. liam: Backend constraints: we only accept integer GPU counts per pool, and burst is expressed as a separate budget in GPU-minutes. So UI should: - Keep min/max as integers (no decimals). - Expose an optional `burst budget` field when burst is enabled (default 0). - Show an inline note: `Burst budget is consumed from dedicated pool capacity; subject to pool limits.` marta: Copy tweaks: - Rename header from "Scaling settings" -> "Capacity & scaling" (more discoverable). - For the min field, placeholder should be `min (reserved GPUs)` not just `min`. - For guardrails: change `SLO guardrail triggered` to `SLO safeguard: action recommended` — less alarming. oliver: Accessibility pass: - Contrast: the grey text used for the tick labels on the SLO slider is failing AA at smaller sizes. Need darker color. - Keyboard: sliders must support left/right arrow with shift for 10-step jumps. Ensure focus outline is visible (not color-only). - Screen reader: add `aria-valuetext` so we say both percent and label (e.g., "Latency SLO: 95% — default"). sam: Also propose making the GPU pool selector searchable and keyboard navigable. We have orgs with 30+ pools and the current dropdown will be a pain. Add small tag that shows pool region and instance type to disambiguate. liam: One implementation constraint: when the user chooses a pool with a different GPU family, we need a validation step that warns if the selected model is incompatible. Can we surface a warning state inline (yellow) and a tooltip with actionable steps? anya: Good point. We should include a compatibility check before saving; maybe an inline badge: `Potential mismatch — verify model quant/arch`. Action item: design to show compat badge + modal confirmation if mismatched. oliver: Minor: avoid using color alone for the warning icon. Add textual prefix like `Warning:` and role="status" so AT picks up immediates. marta: UX flow question: do we want to expose burst cooldown (time window) in the modal or hide it behind advanced settings? My vote: show cooldown only when burst enabled, but collapsed under "advanced" to reduce noise. sam: Agree. Also consider adding a small inline recommendation: `Recommended min based on recent traffic: 4 GPUs` (data from telemetry) — gives users a safe default. liam: We can provide that recommendation from /usage-service, but it's eventual consistency. We should indicate freshness: `Recommended: 4 (based on 3h avg)` so users know it's not exact. anya: Action items: @sam to update Figma for: clearer burst label+tooltip, searchable pool selector, slider ticks+keyboard states. @oliver to draft exact aria attributes and contrast colors. @liam to spec the validation states and the `burst budget` input. @marta to write the copy changes + microcopy for tooltips. I'll then put up a small A/B for the copy change (safeguard language) behind a FF. deploy-bot: Design snippet uploaded to staging: figma-snapshot-1764809123.png (auto). sam: Quick aria example I'd like to use for the SLO slider: ```
``` oliver: That looks good. Also add `aria-describedby` pointing to a small offscreen helper that says `Use arrow keys to change by 1%. Press shift for 10%` so SR users get keyboard instructions. marta: I'm drafting tooltip copy: "Enable burst: temporarily allow extra GPUs beyond reserved capacity. Burst budget limits how long burst can run. Learn more -> docs link." Thoughts? anya: Nice. Let's also add a tiny inline visual showing `burst budget remaining` once burst is enabled (small progress bar + minutes left). liam: Backend note: we'll need an API extension to surface current remaining budget in realtime. I'll open a ticket and mock a response for the UI team. sam: UI QA: keyboard navigation happy path + screen reader labels + contrast fixes. Can we include a small checklist in the PR description so reviewers can verify accessibility claims? oliver: I'll prepare a short checklist. Also recommend we test with NVDA/VoiceOver on the modal before shipping. anya: Great. Timeline: sam + oliver + marta update Figma & copy by EOD Fri. liam will spec API by Mon. We'll reconvene next Tue 10am for final sign-off. Thanks all :+1: sam: :thumbsup: liam: on it marta: noted and will add copy doc oliver: adding checklist to the thread
